description: Defines classes for initializing pseudo-random generator sequences, specifically for x1(n) and x2(n), including methods for sequence initialization, state retrieval, and reverse computation, within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: pseudo_random_initializer_x1
classes.description: Initializes and manages the state of the x1(n) pseudo-random sequence.

classes.name: pseudo_random_initializer_x2
classes.description: Initializes and manages the state of the x2(n) pseudo-random sequence, supporting multiple seed states.

methods.name: get_reverse
methods.description: Computes the sequence state after initialization from a given initial state or seed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence state after initialization from a specified initial state.
